Refitting

Open the bonnet lid.
1. (For the left headlamp only) Undo the bolts (1a) and remove the left engine compartment protection (1b).

1. Release the retainers (1a) and remove the cover (1b).

2. Release the bulb holder and bulb from the housing.

3. Extract the bulb from the bulb holder (bayonet mount).

Refitting

Removing

Check the condition and the cleanliness of the lamp.

Fit the bulb in the bulb holder.

Fit the bulb holder with bulb in its seat.

Position the cover and attach the retainers.

For the left headlamp only. Position the left engine compartment protection and secure it using the bolts.

Close the bonnet lid.

Check the operation of the bulb.
